Source-init and package-init baseline controls invoke the real candidate CLI; both supported hosts have positive inventory controls. Freeze selected native assertion/argv/host before execution. vendorReference.challengeOrigin: Fresh private source inventory for each of the 1090 byte/mode challenges; baseline and restoration cover the entire approved inventory. Additional source/init/package/package-init controls use their own approved origin modes.
vendorReference.modeEvaluationOrder: Proposed validator must lstat and assert exact mode before reading content, so removing owner read permission is detected by the owned mode assertion rather than credited as an EACCES setup error. This behavior is proposed, not implemented.
vendorReference.forbiddenInventory: Reject obsidian-prefixed skills, __pycache__, .pyc/.pyo, missing/extra/duplicate paths and external symlinks. References may not be rebuilt from mutated inputs or comparator output.
vendorReference.limits: One append-newline challenge and nine single-bit XOR mode challenges per file, not every possible byte edit or proof of the seven unavailable legacy identities. Native end-to-end cell duration and verdict quality remain unverified.
